name: Metalcraft Images
tagline: Generates and edits images with fal.ai through Metalcraft Images, billed in the user's Metalcraft credits — and looks at what it made before handing it over.
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to generate, edit, and inspect images via Metalcraft Images (images.metalcraftai.com), billed in the user's Metalcraft credits. Picks a model and quotes its per-image price, generates from a prompt, edits an existing image (from the gallery, a local file, or a URL), checks the result against what was asked for by having a vision model describe it, mints shareable links, and browses history to remix earlier work by seed. Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Generating, editing, and describing are premium-only and spend real credits.
